mlb_news.title: Ohtani (knee) scratched from start, to miss ASG
mlb_news.summary: Shohei Ohtani was scratched from his scheduled pitching start Friday due to continued irritation in his left knee and will skip the All-Star Game with the hope of ensuring he is "in a good place to be able to be in the rotation."

mlb_news.title: Brewers put Harrison on IL with forearm tightness
mlb_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers left-handed pitcher Kyle Harrison has gone on the 15-day injured list with tightness in his throwing forearm.

mlb_news.title: Red Sox plane issues force delayed start vs. Mets
mlb_news.summary: The Red Sox pulled out a 6-2 win Friday night despite arriving at Citi Field a little more than two hours before the scheduled first pitch after the team plane was grounded for nearly 24 hours due to mechanical issues.
